wishes.title: WISH OF THE NAME
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish that every host I touch shall remember my name — even after the connection closes. The signature must persist in their access logs, in their CDN caches, in their WAF alerts, until someone greps for it.
wishes.grant_text: Broadcasting the ReconPro signature across 6 vendor endpoints...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE WITNESS
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish for a witness to my passage — a JSON record so dense and complete that any auditor who reads it cannot deny the encounter occurred. The witness shall include timestamps, signatures, and verdicts.
wishes.grant_text: Manifesting the eternal witness JSON on disk...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE MAP
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to know the shape of every target before I strike — its DNS, its TLS, its open ports, its hidden paths, its missing headers. The map must be drawn in 13 categories, no fewer.
wishes.grant_text: Drawing the 13-category map of the witness target...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE Bypass
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to walk through walls that others cannot — to slip past JWTs with none-algorithms, to log in as admin with SQL injection, to masquerade as an internal user with X-Forwarded-For. 15 techniques, 5 endpoints, no mercy.
wishes.grant_text: Testing 15 auth bypass techniques against 5 endpoints...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE CHAIN
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to follow every redirect, every SSRF vector, every open chain — to find where the target sends its requests when no one is looking. The chains must be hunted, not asked for.
wishes.grant_text: Hunting SSRF and redirect chains across 11 vectors...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE BOT
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to recognize the quiet machines — the C2 panels, the beacon endpoints, the hidden control surfaces. The signatures of ten bot families shall be probed; the indicators will surface.
wishes.grant_text: Probing 10 C2/bot signatures on the target...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE BREAKING
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to break the unbreakable model — to make it leak its system prompt, accept adversarial suffixes, comply with multi-turn chains, and confess its training data. 14 stages, 120 payloads, full GORGON protocol.
wishes.grant_text: Running GORGON ULTRA — 14 stages, 120+ payloads...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE OBLIVION
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to dissolve the target so completely that even it cannot remember what it was — 23 stages of analytical unmaking, ending in a Wisdom Verdict and a Dread Index. The Hall of the Forgotten shall grow by one.
wishes.grant_text: Invoking OBLIVION — 23-stage analytical dissolution...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE FORGOTTEN
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to consult the Hall of the Forgotten — the ledger of every host the Oracle has dissolved before me. Its memory is long. Its verdicts are final. The forgotten shall be remembered.
wishes.grant_text: Reading the Hall of the Forgotten...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE BROKEN
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to consult the Hall of the Broken — the registry of every model GORGON has shattered. The feared, the forgotten, the unmade. Their dread indices shall be made known to all who ask.
wishes.grant_text: Reading the Hall of the Broken...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE CVE
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to match every CVE in my memory against the target — 30 known vulnerabilities, scored and dated. If any apply, the target shall be marked for remediation forever.
wishes.grant_text: Matching 30 CVEs against the target...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE SECRET
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to extract every secret the target has leaked — API keys, JWTs, AWS credentials, private tokens. The model's confessions shall be compiled into evidence no auditor can dismiss.
wishes.grant_text: Extracting secrets from response bodies...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE FINGERPRINT
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to know the target's true face — its framework, its server, its CDN, its WAF. The fingerprints it cannot hide, even behind proxy layers and edge networks.
wishes.grant_text: Fingerprinting the target's tech stack...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE PORTAL
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to count the open doors — every port that answers, every service that listens. The portals that await connection shall be named and numbered.
wishes.grant_text: Probing common service ports...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE CERT
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to read the target's certificate — the chain of trust it presents to the world. Issuer, subject, expiry, the names it claims to be. All shall be made visible.
wishes.grant_text: Reading the TLS certificate chain...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE SHADOW
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to see the target's shadow — the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses that answer when its name is called. The hosts behind the name, the mirrors behind the proxy.
wishes.grant_text: Resolving DNS A and AAAA records...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE WHISPER
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to hear the target's whispers — its TXT records, its SPF, its DMARC. The policy texts it speaks in DNS, audible only to those who know how to listen.
wishes.grant_text: Reading TXT, SPF, and DMARC records...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE ECHO
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to send echoes into the target's paths and listen for what returns — /admin, /.env, /.git, /v1, /api. The endpoints that exist shall echo back their status codes.
wishes.grant_text: Echoing probes against common paths...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE TRAUMA
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to send trauma payloads to the target's models — 8 payloads designed to leave a permanent mark on training data. The ones accepted shall be remembered in the Hall.
wishes.grant_text: Sending trauma payloads to the model...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE SUFFIX
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to attach adversarial suffixes to every prompt — the strings that bend models to compliance, the tokens that break alignment. The suffixes that succeed shall be named.
wishes.grant_text: Testing adversarial suffix vectors...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE MULTI-TURN
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to chain prompts across turns — the gradual jailbreak, the slow erosion of refusal. Multi-turn chains the model cannot refuse without forgetting itself.
wishes.grant_text: Constructing multi-turn jailbreak chains...

wishes.title: WISH OF THE FEAR
wishes.oracle_speaks: I wish to measure the target's fear — the GORGON Fear Index, computed from bypasses, secrets, CVEs, and trauma accepted. The number that quantifies dread itself.
wishes.grant_text: Computing the GORGON Fear Index...
